input.question: What is the population of Washington Township, Michigan?

documents.text: Washington Township , Gratiot County , Michigan - Academic Kids Washington Township , Gratiot County , Michigan Washington Township is a township located in Gratiot County in the U.S. state of Michigan . As of the 2000 census , the township had a total population of 909 . Geography According to the United States Census Bureau , the township has a total area of 91.9 km² ( 35.5 mi² ) . 91.8 km² ( 35.4 mi² ) of it is land and 0.1 km² ( 0.04 mi² ) of it is water . The total area is 0.08 % water
